issuer: Advisory Committee of the Supreme Court of Missouri / Office of Legal Ethics Counsel
title: Missouri Informal Ethics Opinion 930088
text: QUESTION: Attorney wishes to be cautious but would like to include academic degrees and practice areas on letterhead. ANSWER: The letterhead, taken as a whole would imply specialization. Words modifying the practice areas such as “practice limited to” or “practice emphasizing” would be an alternative to the disclaimer required by Rule 7.4.
